name: Weaponeers
detailed_description:
One-sentence description
Weaponeers, a primarily multiplayer game, is centered around making weapons and using them with other players.

Highlights
In Weaponeers, you battle players with weapons you make from scratch, taking place on a series of maps with multiple modes of play. While many games in the First Person Shooter genre are centered around the player, this game is focused on the weapons and their mechanics. Weaponeers sports both an intuitive weapon construction system and a fluid weapon firing system.

Current implementations

This game currently contains a well developed weapon firing and building system, a testing map, an incomplete production-stage map, basic networking code, FPS movement, and a basic user interface

Technical details

Weaponeers is primarily multiplayer, with all of the networking code written from nearly scratch. This game is made with Godot, as an effort to support the open source nature of it.

Words of warning
Note that this game is in its very early stages, so expect to find bugs, low quality assets, and a lack of features.

short_description: Weaponeers is a multiplayer FPS, but instead of being supplied with a selection of weapons, you get to make your own completely from scratch. In Weaponeers, you battle against other players with both your skill and weapon-making wits, featuring a blend of both creativity and competitiveness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 Series/Intel i3 Series
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics for above processors
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any modern or semi-modern soundcard
  • VR Support: No VR devices supported or required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 Series/Intel i5 Series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics for above processors, or external AMD or NVIDIA graphics card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any modern or semi-modern soundcard
  • VR Support: No VR devices supported or required
